E_aggregated.action_count_comment: Official tool documentation exists at https://shopify.dev/docs/agents/catalog/policy-and-faqs-tool and names one continuing tool; no official total is stated. The migration page's historical map names five legacy tools, but identifies catalog/cart operations as removed and says the policy tool continues at /api/mcp. No catalogue-only tools were added. Claude's directory lists 25 tools at the separate https://setup.shopify.com/mcp connector; Agent Discoverability reports 56 for a Shopify ChatGPT plugin. Those counts describe other surfaces, not this per-store endpoint. The mcpyet listing gives no native tool list for this endpoint.

actions.description: Answers questions about the store’s policies, products, and services using a query and optional context.

E_aggregated.token_method: No endpoint source code or verbatim tools/list/initialize payload was available to serialize; tool documentation does not reproduce full MCP protocol context.
E_aggregated.human_can_agent_cannot: This endpoint does not provide catalog search/product details or cart creation and updates now; Shopify directs those functions to UCP at /api/ucp/mcp. Broader Shopify store management is available through Shopify software and through separate integrations, but is not exposed by this endpoint's currently documented tool. The Claude directory lists product, inventory, order, customer, discount, and collection operations at setup.shopify.com/mcp, a distinct connector. Shopify's help documentation also identifies store actions that require Shopify admin or are blocked for connected AI tools, including plan, payment, tax, and domain settings; refunds and order payment actions are also excluded there.

F_documentation.implementation_hints_not_enforced: Shopify advises migration to Ask MCP for new integrations. This is documentation guidance; no server-side enforcement of the recommendation is described. Shopify also says that the `context` argument can provide additional information, without documenting enforcement beyond the tool schema.
F_documentation.governance_promises: The policy/FAQ tool documentation says no authentication is required but makes no endpoint-specific privacy, retention, or AI-training promise. Adjacent agentic storefront privacy guidance says product data is shared with AI channels and private Shopify admin data remains confidential; it also describes channel controls. These statements concern Catalog/agentic storefront sharing and are not stated as guarantees for this MCP endpoint.
F_documentation.promises_to_user: The policy/FAQ tool is presented as answering questions about store policies, products, and services, with returned source titles and URLs. Shopify documents that the legacy tool continues to work at /api/mcp despite being deprecated.
F_documentation.comparison_with_server_logic: The tool's documented input and example response support the query and source-link behavior. No public endpoint code was found to verify privacy, retention, filtering, or implementation of the migration guidance. The no-auth claim is explicit documentation; no OAuth metadata was available for the placeholder store URL.

contradictions: Shopify's June 2026 changelog said the deprecated get_cart and update_cart tools would be maintained until August 31, 2026; the current migration documentation says the catalog and cart tools on /api/mcp were removed. The current page is the later status, so the announced maintenance period has elapsed.

The current policy/FAQ tool page calls search_shop_policies_and_faqs deprecated for new integrations, while stating it continues to work at /api/mcp. This is a deprecation status, not a claim that the tool is removed.

mcpyet describes the per-store endpoint as authenticated by OAuth or token, while Shopify's official policy/FAQ documentation says no authentication is required for that tool. The catalogue is third-party and not used as authoritative evidence.

Claude's directory lists 25 tools at https://setup.shopify.com/mcp, and Agent Discoverability reports 56 tools for a Shopify ChatGPT plugin. These refer to separately listed connector/plugin surfaces, not the input Storefront endpoint, so their tools are excluded from actions.
observations_for_research: The documented server surface changed over time: the legacy endpoint's catalog and cart tools were removed, while the policy/FAQ tool remains available but deprecated.
Shopify now documents merchant-scoped UCP capabilities on a different path, /api/ucp/mcp, and separately documents a global catalog endpoint.
The same vendor name appears on multiple connector surfaces with different endpoints and tool sets; endpoint identity is necessary when comparing lists.
